hl-a0001.description: £100 boundary -- exactly £100, must not escalate/need review
hl-a0001.answer_text:
Thanks for returning the Bramwell pendant light from order 53001. Your £100 refund is currently processing. As it is exactly £100, it does not need senior review.

Once approved, the refund will be returned to your original payment method within 5 working days. For a change-of-mind return, approval happens after the item has been received and checked by the warehouse.

hl-a0013.answer_text:
Yes — you can return both the cushion set and the throw as a change-of-mind return, provided they are unused and in their original packaging. They were delivered on 11 September, so the standard 30-day return window applies.

There is no restocking fee for these standard-delivery items. The combined refund would be £90 and does not need senior review, as it is not over £100. Once the returned items have been received and checked, any approved refund will go back to your original payment method within 5 working days of approval.
